response.sql:
WITH snap AS (
  SELECT t.transreg, t.ordertypedist, AVG(s.instownpct) AS own
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = s.transref
  WHERE t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY t.transreg, t.ordertypedist
),
units AS (
  SELECT transreg, ordertypedist, own,
    AVG(own) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) AS mix_base,
    AVG(own) OVER () AS overall
  FROM snap
  WHERE own IS NOT NULL
),
kept AS (
  SELECT * FROM units WHERE own > overall
)
SELECT AVG(own) AS avg_kept_ownership,
  AVG(own / mix_base) AS avg_ratio_to_mix_baseline,
  AVG(own - overall) AS avg_excess_over_overall
FROM kept;

assumptions.assumption: Each transaction has a single ordertypedist value (it is a column on transactionrecord), so one unit corresponds to one transaction, and snapshots are linked by an inner join so unmatched snapshots drop out.
Units whose snapshots all lack instownpct have no ownership value and are excluded before computing the mix baselines and overall average, since AVG ignores NULLs and such units cannot be compared.
Mix baselines and the overall average are computed over all units (before the strict-above filter), as the request states, and the overall average is over units rather than over raw snapshots.
